marta: @here quick broadcast — at ~03:46 UTC we observed failed key fetches from the private-kms service for Private-agent fleets in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. A subset of private deployments returned 401/502 when attempting signed requests. We routed affected agents to a read-only fallback and kicked off mitigations. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2367891234

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-774 created · severity: high · services: private-kms, private-agent, private-control-plane · start: 2026-11-02T03:46:34Z

kevin: quick timeline: 03:44 scheduled KMS rolling rotation started for eu-west keybundle -> 03:45 several agent heartbeats failed during rotation window -> 03:46 automated fallback engaged for private agents -> 03:52 rollback of key rotation initiated after spike in auth failures.

lia: mitigation summary: 1) aborted rotation and rolled back to previous key material 2) triggered agent reconnect workflow with backoff reset 3) enabled temporary proxying to hosted-kms for tenants that opted in for emergency fallback. This restored agent auth for ~95% of fleets by 04:00.

ops: runbook commands we executed: ```curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://private-kms.eu-west-1.internal/health``` and ```kubectl -n private-control get pods -l app=private-agent -o wide```  we also inspected agent logs: ```/var/log/private-agent/agent.log | tail -n 200 | grep "auth error"```  no remaining 502s on most clusters after reconnect.

kevin: root cause hypothesis: a bug in the rotation sequencer caused a short window where agent cert validation used mixed key versions during concurrent refresh. We're freezing automatic rotations until the sequencer has additional guards.

support: customer impact summary: ~27 private tenants experienced transient failures (most recovered automatically). We posted a banner to the Private Console at 04:07 UTC and sent targeted emails to tenants with persistent errors. Draft: "We experienced a brief auth disruption for some Private deployments during a KMS rotation between 03:44-03:52 UTC. Most services are back to normal; if you're still affected please contact support and reference incident INC-2026-774."

lia: follow-ups: 1) add circuit-breaker in rotation sequencer 2) add canary agents that validate rotation externally before cutover 3) create a synthetic test job to run rotations in staging with agent reconnect verification.

kevin: verification commands: ```./tools/kms_verify.py --region eu-west-1 --since 03:30``` and monitor: `grafana/dashboard/private-kms -> auth_errors`  graphs show peak at rotation time and return-to-baseline by 04:00.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated · monitoring · link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2367891234 · postmortem: scheduled 2026-11-03T15:30Z

marta: thanks for the quick action. Please add any log excerpts or alert thresholds to the postmortem doc. If you see residual auth errors reopen this thread or ping me directly. :shield:
